column1: # Power circuit map. Loads use the unit of load_status.txt.
# 1. No circuit may carry more than its max_load.
# 2. Load is only moved between the two circuits. The sum
#    of both must stay equal to the sum in load_status.txt.
# Field repair: repair circuit_load <CR-A1 load> <CR-B4 load>
# An overload here also weakens the cooling room; that
# clears by itself once the loads are legal again.
